title: German Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired beef stew. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Heat the brown beer in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the German lager beer and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and simmer for 1.5 hours or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
